items.title: Miley Cyrus Leads a Steamy Dance Floor Revolution With New Single and Video for ‘Bass Persuades’
items.summary:
Miley Cyrus has released "Bass Persuades," the title track and lead single from her tenth studio album, along with an accompanying video. The song leans hard into dance-pop, built on 80s-leaning synths and opening with a spoken-word first verse delivered in a flat, unbothered register. "Step into the scene you won't catch an eye / Walk into the party like the party is mine," she sings on the track.

The album arrives September 18 through Atlantic Records, Cyrus' first release under a new deal with the label. It follows two albums released via Columbia, Endless Summer Vacation and Something Beautiful, and the new single sits close in spirit to that record's club-facing cuts like "Walk of Fame" and "Every Girl You've Ever Loved."

Variety reported that the album runs 10 tracks and that Cyrus appears to have dropped her surname for this era, billing herself mononymously. She revealed the title and cover art earlier in the week alongside a note on social media explaining the phrase. "Music takes hold of us. We feel it, sing it, sometimes dance to it, let it out and carry on. It is powerful, vulnerable, sweet and strong," she wrote, adding that the title covers "heart full, heartache, every part of life in between."

Cyrus also announced her return to live performance with two shows at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles on October 16 and 18. Model/Actriz, who appear on Bass Persuades, will open both nights, and the promotional flier indicates Cyrus plans to perform the album in its entirety.

The single and video are out now, with the full record following on September 18 and the Hollywood Bowl dates a month after that.

items.title: Squeeze Cancel Virginia Concert After Man Crushed to Death by Tour Bus
items.summary:
Squeeze canceled their Thursday night concert at Wolf Trap in Vienna, Virginia, after a worker died in the venue's parking lot earlier that day. Police said the man, who has not been publicly identified, was underneath a tour bus when a supporting apparatus gave way and the bus collapsed on him.

Rolling Stone reported the cancellation, citing police accounts relayed through Fox 5. In a statement, the band said they were "deeply saddened and shocked by an incident that occurred at the venue earlier today, which resulted in the loss of a life," and that the decision to call off the performance came after discussions with the venue and authorities. Squeeze added that they would work with the promoter and venue on the possibility of rescheduling and would update ticket holders when they had more information.

Wolf Trap posted its own note on social media, describing "an accident involving a member of the community at Wolf Trap National Park today, tragically resulting in a loss of life," and confirming the show would not go on out of respect.

Squeeze are in the middle of a U.S. tour, with dates scheduled at the Rose Music Center in Huber Heights, Ohio, and in Highland Park, Illinois, on Sunday. The British band released their most recent album, Trixies, in March.

Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts, located just outside Washington, D.C., programs music and arts events across the season. Its next scheduled performance is the National Symphony Orchestra's Jerry Garcia Symphonic Celebration.

items.title: Beyoncé Releases ‘B’Day 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition’ Featuring Unreleased Songs, Collaborations With Selena and Maluma
items.summary:
Beyoncé has released B'Day 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition, a remastered and expanded version of her second solo album, which originally came out on September 4, 2006. The reissue collects Spanish-language recordings, previously released bonus tracks and several songs that have never been heard, and arrives alongside a revamped video for "Déjà Vu" featuring Jay-Z.

Among the new material is "Cuerpo Tumbao (Get Me Bodied)" with Maluma, the first time Beyoncé and the Colombian singer have recorded together. The track samples Celia Cruz's "La Negra Tiene Tumbao" and was produced by Beyoncé, Edgar Barrera and Casta, with co-production from Ali Ali Ali Alvarez.

The package also includes "Irreemplazable (Como La Flor)," a Spanish version of "Irreplaceable" built around previously released vocals from Selena Quintanilla, a duet the late singer's estate approved. Beyoncé, a fellow Texan, has cited hearing Selena on Houston radio as an influence, and the release credits her with inspiring the 2007 Spanish EP Irreemplazable. Other additions include "Can I Watch You," produced by Beyoncé and Pharrell, plus "Morning Dew (Donk)," "My First Time," "Lost Yo Mind," "Creole" and "Back Up."

In a press release shared with Variety, Beyoncé described what she was after two decades ago. "I wanted the album to be big, percussive, hard, up-tempo, and energized, and it was important to me that we used live instrumentation," she said, adding that with hip-hop ascendant at the time, "I was fighting to preserve the bridges, melodies, and harmonies that have always been at the heart of R&B."

Beyond the audio remaster, the album's videos were recolored and finished in 4K for the anniversary release. The deluxe edition is out now.

items.title: Amber Eggers Dies: ‘Love After Lockup’ Star Was 41
items.summary:
Amber Eggers, who appeared on the WEtv reality series Love After Lockup, died Thursday, September 3, at a hospital in Georgia. She was 41. The cause was acute liver failure.

Friends announced her death on social media, and Deadline reported that her mother, Monica Eggers, confirmed it to TMZ. She had been hospitalized with liver failure for two days before she died.

Eggers appeared in the show's second season in 2019, which followed her relationship while she was incarcerated on drug trafficking charges. She was engaged at the time, but the relationship ended after her release from prison.

Her health had been in decline for at least a year. In 2025, her sister Erin started a GoFundMe to help cover medical costs after Eggers was hospitalized with severe pneumonia and a bacterial blood infection. Her sister wrote that Eggers went through physical therapy to regain the ability to walk after leaving the ICU.

items.title: “Choosin’ Texas” by Ella Langley’s biggest streaming city is in Australia
items.summary:
Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" has spent the summer as one of the most-streamed songs on Spotify, and the single city playing it more than any other on earth is Sydney. Internal platform data shows the Australian city ahead of every other market globally for the track between June and August.

Sydney's appetite is not a fluke. Brisbane ranks second among cities streaming the song, and Melbourne sits at No. 5. New York comes in third, making it the top American city for the track, while Dallas — in the state named in the title — lands at No. 4.

Langley released "Choosin' Texas" in October 2025 and it climbed to No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 on February 9, 2026. On August 31, it logged its 20th consecutive week at the top, the longest unbroken run for a non-holiday song.

The FADER reported the Spotify figures, which also show that roughly a third of Langley's total streams between June 1 and August 19 came from outside the United States. Her top 10 markets, in order, were the U.S., Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Brazil, Mexico and Norway.

The pattern tracks with country music's broader footprint on the platform. The genre's non-U.S. share of Spotify streams has held between 42% and 44% across the past four summers, landing at 43% this year, with Canada, the U.K., Australia, Brazil, Germany, the Philippines, Mexico, the Netherlands, Sweden and Indonesia leading international listening. South Korea and Egypt each posted 45% year-over-year growth in country streams, followed by Guatemala at 21% and Peru at 11%.
